Tourism cache 00 identifies the scenic byway but does not document the catalog’s separate state and National Forest designation awards or dates. Cache 01 mixes North Cascades and Sherman Pass designations and has a geographically inconsistent designation paragraph; those claims are omitted.

Stonerose permit and retention rules are supported only by secondary cache 15. Tourism cache 00 confirms visitor fossil digging, but no saved operator rules independently confirm permit details. Checked date records this cache review, not a live access check.
